en: A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a tall, ornate monument (likely an obelisk or war memorial) on a hill, overlooking a river or large body of water. There are ships visible on the water, hills or mountains in the background, and rays of sunlight emanating from the sky. There is printed German text on the left and elaborate cursive handwriting on the right side and bottom of the card.
